nonblocking_findings: F14 [Major] review-c: The in_text() helper in tests/spec_review_gate/test_s3_dispositions_docs.sh:56 runs printf piped into grep -qF under set -uo pipefail. grep -q can exit at the first match, so printf can get a broken pipe, and pipefail makes the check fail.
